request: A user-facing preview becomes wider than the configured character limit whenever it is shortened. Find the text utility responsible and fix it so the final displayed preview, including its omission marker, never exceeds the limit.

Our path guard accepts a sibling directory whose name merely begins with the configured root. Repair the helper that derives a path below a root; it must reject prefix lookalikes while retaining the root itself and real descendants.
Configuration overrides use null to mean leave the default unchanged. One merge helper now erases defaults when a caller leaves an optional setting unspecified. Restore the intended merge behavior.
Retry scheduling produces one delay too many: a request with three retries should wait three times, while zero retries should not wait. Correct the duration helper without changing validation.

Environment-style boolean values with harmless surrounding spaces are rejected even though the same words work without spaces. Find the strict flag converter and make its accepted textual values whitespace tolerant.
Updating a missing query setting silently drops the requested setting. The query helper should replace every existing copy with one value, or add it when absent.
A value exactly at an allowed tolerance distance is being marked outside range. Fix the numerical comparison while preserving invalid-tolerance handling.
A request header sanitizer blocks newline injection but still permits a carriage-return-only payload. Correct the display/request utility to reject either line-ending character.
